about: Questions with known answers, checked against the sources (CPython 3.12 stdlib and shrink itself). An answer is correct when it contains, for every group in 'expect', at least one of the group's strings (case-insensitive). 'needs' says where the answer lives: signature/module code survives the skeleton level, body/docstring does not.
